articles.title: Two New Sea Spider Species Discovered in the Salish Sea — First in Nearly 100 Years
articles.summary: Scientists found two new sea spider species in the Salish Sea, including one with hairy legs and red eyes. It's the first new sea spider discovery there in almost a century.

articles.title: Astronomers Spot a Shock Wave Around a Dead Star That Shouldn't Be There
articles.summary: A dead star called RXJ0528+2838 is producing a giant shock wave, but it lacks the disc that normally powers such outflows. Scientists are baffled and excited.

articles.title: Burning Scrolls to Save Them: A New Way to Read Ancient Texts
articles.summary: Scientists burned their own scrolls to test a technique for reading 2,000-year-old charred scrolls from Herculaneum. Lead in the ink could make hidden writing visible without opening them.
